confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Malacca's tourist pricing; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, and alcohol prices are less certain because Malaysian alcohol taxes vary by venue. Accommodation reflects typical non-peak July rates, not weekend or holiday peaks. FX is from the RBA exchange-rates overview page as surfaced in search results; the full page was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Malaysian heritage and tourist cities such as Ipoh and the lower-cost parts of George Town (Penang), priced somewhat below Kuala Lumpur. Alcohol anchors use the local relationship to beer, with cocktails about 2.5 times and wine about 3 times the draft beer price, because direct knowledge of Malacca bar prices is weak.
